response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component ERF_US_NR_hAHR was analyzed at the assay endpoint, ERF_US_NR_hAHR, in the positive analysis fitting direction relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of binding reporter, gain-of-signal activity can be used to understand changes in binding as they relate to gene AHR. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the nuclear receptor intended target family, where the subfamily is non-steroidal.
response.assayComponentDesc: ERF_US_NR_hAHR is an assay component calculated from the ERF_US_NR_hAHR assay. It is designed to measure radioligand binding using a type of binding reporter as detected by scintillation counting with fluorimetry technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: Changes in chemiluminescence produced from the receptor binding reaction involving the key ligand, FICZ, are indicative of changes in receptor function and kinetics related to the gene AHR.
response.assayDesc: ERF_US_NR_hAHR is a biochemical, single-readout assay that uses extracted gene-proteins in a cell-free assay. Measurements were taken 16 hours after chemical dosing in a 384-well plate. See AHR Human NHR Cell Based Antagonist Protein-Protein Interaction Assay, DiscoverX.
response.assaySourceDesc: Eurofins is an international group of laboratories headquartered in Luxembourg, providing testing and support services to the pharmaceutical, food, environmental, agriscience and consumer products industries and to governments.
